limitations: The 2026-09-03 campaign measured product commit d17100cb8e9cbd157960f352020e21a7a523fddd. Its two earlier stack commits change only the performance harness; the matrix commit adds only evidence and documentation.

All four orientation/theme modes were freshly captured for physical iPad web, physical iPad native, and the three Mac engines. Every drawing and action artifact in those five targets comes from the campaign product commit.

Both physical Android targets have fresh, fidelity-passing drawings in all four modes. Android web has fresh actions in both light modes; its dark-mode direct-CDP sweeps are preserved because theme setup waited for the lazy Settings modal before clicking the button that requests its mount (#1595). Android native actions are preserved in all modes after the same wait-before-demand ordering blocked setup even after the campaign moved from the borrowed Appium to an SDK-configured owned server; landscape modes also retain #1387's separate compact rotation-picker blocker.

The current scorer can score physical iPad native and both physical Android drawing transports: every fresh phase passed the runtime's measured fidelity checks and matched its declared refresh regime. Their manifest fidelity classes remain advisory because ADR-0156 separates instrument calibration from the rule that all four physical rows gate campaign completion; a preserved action section on either Android row therefore remains explicitly historical release-gate evidence.

Simulator and emulator rows are advisory and never count toward campaign completion under ADR-0156. Both iPad Simulator rows are preserved after fresh Safari attempts failed input cadence. Android emulator web is preserved because portrait content-offset geometry is uncalibrated and landscape non-pen brushes produced unchanged-canvas verdicts. Android emulator native portrait is preserved for the same geometry gap; its two landscape drawing modes are fresh and fidelity-passing, with actions preserved because the compact Settings shell cannot perform rotation setup.

Action cells are scored under ADR-0156: a post-action max breach counts only when two of the three scored repeats show it; a single breaching repeat is recorded as unconfirmed rather than red. Read each artifact's scoredActionFrameGaps rather than treating the pooled P95/P99/max triple as three repeats.

Android physical web and native drawing use the ADR-0135 split input/measurement transport. Fresh artifacts record driving cadence, input fidelity, refresh regime, and page identity. Split-native captures also attest that art.splotch.app was the foreground package.

Stale 60 Hz peak/min refresh-rate pins were removed from the physical Android phone before the accepted captures; its drawing artifacts then matched the declared 120 Hz regime. The emulator remained at its declared 60 Hz regime.

The campaign accepted every faithful red drawing or action gate and did not rerun a valid result to turn it green. Retries were reserved for transport, readiness, input-fidelity, and unchanged-canvas failures.
Physical iPad capture needs a root-owned RemoteXPC tunnel before iOS 26 XCUITest discovery sees the device. See docs/PROFILING-IPAD.md.

A landscape phone renders the compact Settings shell, which offers quick toggles and a pointer to portrait instead of the section list. Compare action modes against the same recorded settingsShell; a different label set between portrait and landscape is a shell difference, not a regression.
Firefox is Gecko, which no Splotch deployment target ships; read it as the third desktop browser a parent might open splotch.art in, never as evidence about WebKit or Blink.

Desktop captures used exact 1366×915 or 915×1366 CSS viewports at DPR 2 — iPad Pro 12.9 geometry, so the canvas area matches the physical-iPad rows. Playwright retains the requested page viewport regardless of the browser window size.

Raw perf-profiles are local scratch and are mostly untracked. ADR-0138 keeps representative whole captures under perf-profiles/evidence/; every section not promoted from this campaign is marked preserved before the strict regeneration.

preservedEvidence.reason: The 2026-09-03 campaign preserves only sections it could not recapture faithfully: both iPad Simulator rows; Android emulator web; Android emulator native portrait and both landscape action sections; Android physical web dark-mode actions; and every Android physical native action section. The physical Android action blocks are #1595's lazy-Settings wait-before-demand ordering plus #1387's compact rotation-picker contract in native landscape modes; advisory targets also hit uncalibrated content geometry, unchanged-canvas, or input-cadence failures. Preserved sections retain their original product commits and do not claim currency. Representative fresh evidence is promoted under the perf-profiles/evidence/2026-09-03-deployment-target-matrix* campaign directories.
